title: Ben at the Hotel
setting: The lobby of a big hotel with a front desk and a guest computer.

characters.name: Ben
characters.look: Ben, a young boy with short brown hair and a blue shirt

characters.name: Dad
characters.look: his dad, a tall man with a short beard and a gray jacket

sentences.en: Ben and his dad arrive at a big hotel.
sentences.zh: 本和爸爸到了一家大酒店。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben, a young boy with short brown hair and a blue shirt and his dad, a tall man with a short beard and a gray jacket walk into a big hotel lobby pulling suitcases.

sentences.en: Ben's phone has no internet here.
sentences.zh: 本的手机在这里上不了网。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben, a young boy with short brown hair and a blue shirt frowns at his phone in the hotel lobby.

sentences.en: He is lucky: the hotel has a computer.
sentences.zh: 他运气不错：酒店有一台电脑。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben, a young boy with short brown hair and a blue shirt smiles and points at a computer on a desk in the lobby.

sentences.en: He sends Leo an email about the hotel website.
sentences.zh: 他给利奥发了一封电子邮件，介绍酒店的网站。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben, a young boy with short brown hair and a blue shirt types at the lobby computer, the screen showing the hotel's web page.

sentences.en: Then he takes photos with his new camera.
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben, a young boy with short brown hair and a blue shirt takes a photo of the grand lobby with a small camera.

sentences.en: Soon Leo sends him a happy message.
sentences.zh: 很快，利奥给他回了一条开心的消息。
sentences.scene_prompt: The lobby computer screen shows a big smiley face; Ben, a young boy with short brown hair and a blue shirt grins.

sentences.en: Dad uses the desk telephone to call home.
sentences.zh: 爸爸用前台的电话给家里打电话。
sentences.scene_prompt: his dad, a tall man with a short beard and a gray jacket talks on an old telephone at the hotel front desk.

sentences.en: Next, Dad gets a hot drink from a machine.
sentences.zh: 接着，爸爸从机器里买了一杯热饮。
sentences.scene_prompt: his dad, a tall man with a short beard and a gray jacket takes a cup of hot coffee from a drinks machine while Ben, a young boy with short brown hair and a blue shirt watches.
